Bedroom 6's three lamps are designed and measured in a scratch copy (hanging lantern on chain at 54,15,67; standing lanterns at 56,11,64 and 51,11,67: min 10, 0 dim, 0 dark on all 35 cells), and written at the end of parts/room-26.mjs.
runParts refuses all four writes because the mansion shell fills this air, so build.nbt still has bedroom 6 dark (min 0, 0 placed, 4 refused). The blocker is shell.mjs plus the runParts air lock, not the lighting.
The room is not lit in build.nbt, so this part is not finished.
left: Bedroom 6 is dark in build.nbt: runParts refused the 4 lamp writes (54,16,67 chain; 54,15,67, 56,11,64, 51,11,67 lanterns) because shell.mjs box() and the wing fills (px/pz at x50, z63, z69, y11..16) write 'air' into the room box, and runParts locks air as well as blocks. Fix belongs to the shell owner (stop filling never-built interior with air, or carve less) or the runParts owner (do not lock air fills). I did not touch shell.mjs or the build library.

Bedroom 6's furniture is also unbuilt: the same lock refused every write in room-26, so the lamp spots assume the designer's layout (bed head 54,11,64 with the foot at 54,11,65; nightstands at 53 and 55 on z64; chest 57; table 56..57 z66; rug x53..54 z67..68). Those spots must be re-checked once the furniture lands.
The designer's request to check the light map with the furniture in the full build cannot be done yet. The light map was measured only in a scratch copy with no furniture.

Same root cause as the bedroom 6 refusal, so other wing rooms are also unlit: bedroom 5, bedroom 7, wing balcony walk and wing walkway each report 0 placed (wing walkway's lanterns on chains at x49 were refused too).
Two-lamp option, if the shell is fixed and fewer lamps are wanted: hanging lantern 54,15,67 plus standing lantern 52,11,64 gives min 7 with one dim cell (51,11,67), so it misses the 8+ target.

structured_output.summary:
Bedroom 6's three lamps are designed and measured in a scratch copy (hanging lantern on chain at 54,15,67; standing lanterns at 56,11,64 and 51,11,67: min 10, 0 dim, 0 dark on all 35 cells), and written at the end of parts/room-26.mjs.
runParts refuses all four writes because the mansion shell fills this air, so build.nbt still has bedroom 6 dark (min 0, 0 placed, 4 refused). The blocker is shell.mjs plus the runParts air lock, not the lighting.
The room is not lit in build.nbt, so this part is not finished.
left: Bedroom 6 is dark in build.nbt: runParts refused the 4 lamp writes (54,16,67 chain; 54,15,67, 56,11,64, 51,11,67 lanterns) because shell.mjs box() and the wing fills (px/pz at x50, z63, z69, y11..16) write 'air' into the room box, and runParts locks air as well as blocks. Fix belongs to the shell owner (stop filling never-built interior with air, or carve less) or the runParts owner (do not lock air fills). I did not touch shell.mjs or the build library.

Bedroom 6's furniture is also unbuilt: the same lock refused every write in room-26, so the lamp spots assume the designer's layout (bed head 54,11,64 with the foot at 54,11,65; nightstands at 53 and 55 on z64; chest 57; table 56..57 z66; rug x53..54 z67..68). Those spots must be re-checked once the furniture lands.
The designer's request to check the light map with the furniture in the full build cannot be done yet. The light map was measured only in a scratch copy with no furniture.

Same root cause as the bedroom 6 refusal, so other wing rooms are also unlit: bedroom 5, bedroom 7, wing balcony walk and wing walkway each report 0 placed (wing walkway's lanterns on chains at x49 were refused too).
Two-lamp option, if the shell is fixed and fewer lamps are wanted: hanging lantern 54,15,67 plus standing lantern 52,11,64 gives min 7 with one dim cell (51,11,67), so it misses the 8+ target.

waste.what: Found the lamp spots by hand: the room tool's top suggestion (54,11,64) is the bed head, so I tested free cells one spec at a time in a scratch copy of build.nbt.
waste.cost: about 8 scratch builds and room checks, plus 3 make.sh rebuilds to find the refusal and the missing B import
waste.tool: A `mcd room --try-lamps 'hang:54,15,67;stand:56,11,64'` flag that measures candidate lamps on the in-memory grid and skips the runParts lock, and that excludes the designer's bed and furniture cells from the suggestions.

waste.what: Worked out the lock refusal by rebuilding and reading parts-report.json: the report says the cell is 'air' but not which earlier part owns it.
waste.cost: 3 full rebuilds (about 1 minute each) to confirm the lock
waste.tool: runParts' refusal report should name the owning part and the fill call (for example 'shell: box() fill air'), so a lamplighter sees at once that the shell owns the air, not the room.

companions.role: mansion shell owner (the masonry designer for parts/shell.mjs)
companions.task: Stop writing 'air' fills over the wing upper interior (box() and the px/pz walls at y11..16) so the room air stays unclaimed, or carve less, and confirm bedroom 6, bedroom 5, bedroom 7 and the wing walkway accept their writes.
Build the furniture the lamps assume (bed head 54,11,64, nightstands 53 and 55 on z64, chest 57, table 56..57 z66, rug x53..54 z67..68), then recheck the light map and the lamp spots.
